brief:
French President Emmanuel Macron told the UN General Assembly that the Gaza situation was a "spectacle that shames us all," Middle East Eye reported. Speaking at his last address to the assembly at UN headquarters in New York, Macron criticized the international community's response to events in Gaza.

The comments come as Macron prepares to step down as French president following the country's presidential elections.
dek: France's Macron says ‘shame on all of us’ for Gaza inaction French President Emmanuel Macron said that the situation in Gaza was a "spectacle that shames us all" as he gave his last speech to the United Nations General Assembly at UN headquarters in New York…
title: Macron calls Gaza situation shameful at final UN address
